breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states that ω must be converted to radians/second using the formula ω = 2π(rpm/60), and explicitly notes 'where ω is converted to radians/second'. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction to substitute rpm directly as ω. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which simply states to use ω = 2π(rpm/60) without the erroneous direct substitution instruction.
